name: glare-card
title: Glare Card
description: A flat, laminated card with a foil sheen: a soft band of colour and a sharp white glint slide across it as the pointer moves, the way a hologram on an ID card or a trading card catches light. The card itself never tilts (for tilt, use Tilt Card).

meta.reducedMotion: A still, faint sheen at one angle; no glint movement.
meta.useWhen: Passes, tickets, membership cards, collectibles, certificates: one small card that is a physical object.
meta.avoidWhen: Large surfaces (the blend is paint-heavy: its cost grows with area); photos of people; grids of many cards; anything that must look sober.
